question.problem: Use a calculator to evaluate ${log}_{11}⁡(7)$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Let's calculate ${log}_{11}⁡(7)$ by changing the base $11$ to the common logarithm (base $10$).

We use the change of base formula:

$$
{log}_{a}⁡X=\frac{{log}_{b}⁡X}{{log}_{b}⁡a}
$$

In our case, $a=11,$ $X=7,$ $b=10.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{11}⁡(7) & =\frac{{log}_{10}⁡(7)}{{log}_{10}⁡(11)} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{log}⁡(7)}{\operatorname{log}⁡(11)} \\  & ≈\frac{0.845\,098}{1.041\,393} \\  & ≈0.812\end{aligned}
$$
